result.response:
Running all developer tests via defects4j to ensure no regressions have been introduced. I'll wait for the tests to finish.
### Investigation & Root Cause

In [`Complex.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L150-L155), the [`add(Complex rhs)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L150-L155) method was missing a check for NaN values. According to the method specification:
> *"If either this or `rhs` has a NaN value in either part, `NaN` is returned; otherwise Infinite and NaN values are returned in the parts of the result according to the rules for `Double` arithmetic."*

Because the check was missing, adding a complex number with a NaN imaginary component (such as `new Complex(1, Double.NaN)`) to a finite complex number resulted in `(real + 1, Double.NaN)` rather than `Complex.NaN` where both real and imaginary parts are `Double.NaN`. This caused the assertion `Assert.assertTrue(Double.isNaN(w.getReal()))` in [`ComplexTest.testAddNaN`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/ComplexTest.java#L110-L118) to fail.

### Solution

Added the check to [`Complex.add(Complex rhs)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L150-L155):
```java
        if (isNaN || rhs.isNaN) {
            return NaN;
        }
```
This aligns [`add`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L150) with the behavior of [`subtract`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L449), [`multiply`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L362), and [`divide`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/complex/Complex.java#L213).

### Verification

- Ran `org.apache.commons.math.complex.ComplexTest::testAddNaN`: passed (0 failures).
- Ran all developer tests in the project via `defects4j test`: passed (0 failures).
- Generated the patch file [blind_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_53_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
